cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've added a red dot beside yours on the portrait. Reserved for a more adventurous exhibition; that's what the gallery meant.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My dot marks the chipped frame. They're showing a fridge full of teeth. What did they say about mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Frame noted, yes. They said the face doesn't immediately reveal what you intended.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's you. They called it unrecognisable, didn't they?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They think knowing the sitter would help. I'll attend your next opening in a matching shirt.

reason: Copied gallery mark creates false positive certainty; A covers actual frame meaning and keeps softening critique into personal support.
